result.summary: Three completed payments are missing confirmed callbacks (E001). Attempts existed for all three, with four HTTP 503 responses and no acknowledgements (E003); the queue was healthy (E004). Escalate to merchant integration for human review of the receiver responses. The failure domain is localized, but the underlying cause is not confirmed; provider status is stale (E005).
result.failure_domain: Callback receiver responses: attempts for all three affected payments received HTTP 503 responses and none were acknowledged (E003). The pre-dispatch queue was healthy (E004). This localizes the customer-visible failure domain to the receiver side, but does not establish why it returned 503; provider status is stale for this incident (E005).
